taskResults.notes: Codex is spawned with --ignore-user-config and claude with --setting-sources project --strict-mcp-config, from one exported helper; isolation 'off' restores the pre-phase argv; a nonzero exit whose stderr names a passed -- flag gets a hint; no retry. 28 new tests; nine argv pins updated in the existing client test, nothing else. Independent review PASS; full pipeline 28/28 re-verified on the main thread. Known: the hint can fire if a wrapper echoes its command line (bounded: it says 'may'); the model variants (-m / --model after the flags) were not measured by the probe.

verification.hostCliIsolation ('on'|'off', optional, absent = on), threaded through VerifierSelectOptions to all seven host-cli verifiers and read at all seven call sites; a test-only spawnImpl seam on the selectors. 90 new tests: each selector x codex/claude x off/absent/on by exact argv, each call site through its real service, AC-4's spawn-once, warn text, refused error and no-hint cases. During the implementer's red run the claude-family tests reached the real claude binary (the seam did not exist yet); every spawning test now runs under an empty-PATH guard. AC-1.reason: buildInvocation inserts codex flags before the model; client tests assert exact argv, stdin delivery, and Linux spawn options without env.

AC-2.reason: Family inference and buildInvocation produce the required claude argv; client tests cover both models and my-reviewer.

AC-3.reason: Factory and seven call sites forward isolation; tests cover every selector, on/off/absent, loadConfig rejection, default omission, and fresh init.

AC-4.reason: Nonzero exits append the first matching passed flag hint; client and selector tests cover single spawn, fallback/refusal, ordering, and no-hint cases.

AC-5.reason: Successful spawned results carry flags through gates into provenance. Tests cover all three gates, exclusions, historical parsing, and summary verify MATCH.

AC-6.reason: Doctor uses configured seam providers and injected env without spawning; tests assert exact messages, severities, custom binary, and runDoctor integration.

AC-7.reason: Docs and minor changeset describe both flag sets, residual instructions, inferred effects, opt-out, doctor, and provenance; doc-content tests assert these.
